# DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION ANALYSES
```{r}
# RNA counts
RNA_counts <- RNA_counts_2wk %>%
  dplyr::select(-PID)

# metadata for participants with ED/WK2/M6 RNA samples
DEA_metadata_2wk <- metadata_ICs_2wk %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID, Timepoint) %>%
  inner_join(RRS_df_median_2wk, by = "PID")


# merge metadata + counts
DEA_data_2wk <- DEA_metadata_2wk %>%
  dplyr::select(-X) %>%
  inner_join(RNA_counts, by = "INVENTORY.CODE") %>%
  dplyr::select(-X)

rownames(DEA_data_2wk) <- DEA_data_2wk$INVENTORY.CODE

# define metadata columns explicitly
meta_cols <- c("INVENTORY.CODE", "PID", "Timepoint", "RRS", "Group", "RRS_median_group")

coldata_2wk <- DEA_data_2wk %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(meta_cols))

count_matrix_2wk <- DEA_data_2wk %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(meta_cols))

all(sapply(count_matrix_2wk, is.numeric))

# transpose counts
count_matrix_t_2wk <- t(as.matrix(count_matrix_2wk))
colnames(count_matrix_t_2wk) <- rownames(DEA_data_2wk)

# final alignment checks
identical(colnames(count_matrix_t_2wk), rownames(coldata_2wk))
identical(rownames(coldata_2wk), DEA_data_2wk$INVENTORY.CODE)

# factors
coldata_2wk$PID <- factor(coldata_2wk$PID)
coldata_2wk$Timepoint <- factor(coldata_2wk$Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6"))
coldata_2wk$RRS_median_group <- factor(coldata_2wk$RRS_median_group,
                                       levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"))

# global filtering + normalization on 3-timepoint subset
dge_global_2wk <- DGEList(
  counts = round(count_matrix_t_2wk),
  genes = rownames(count_matrix_t_2wk))

keep_2wk <- filterByExpr(dge_global_2wk, group = coldata_2wk$Timepoint, min.count = 3)
dge_global_2wk <- dge_global_2wk[keep_2wk, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_global_2wk <- calcNormFactors(dge_global_2wk)

cat("Genes retained after global filtering:", nrow(dge_global_2wk), "\n")

output_dir <- "2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

groups_to_run <- c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS")

comparisons <- list(
  list(name = "ED_vs_WK2", t1 = "ED",  t2 = "WK2"),
  list(name = "WK2_vs_M6", t1 = "WK2", t2 = "M6"),
  list(name = "ED_vs_M6",  t1 = "ED",  t2 = "M6"))

all_results_2wk_pairwise <- list()

param <- SerialParam()

for (grp in groups_to_run) {
  
  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Processing group:", grp, "\n")
  cat("============================\n")
  
  group_metadata_all <- coldata_2wk %>%
    filter(RRS_median_group == grp)
  
  cat("  Samples:", nrow(group_metadata_all), "\n")
  cat("  Participants:", n_distinct(group_metadata_all$PID), "\n")
  
  tp_check <- group_metadata_all %>%
    count(PID, name = "n_samples") %>%
    count(n_samples, name = "n_PIDs")
  print(tp_check)
  
  for (comp in comparisons) {
    
    comp_name <- comp$name
    t1 <- comp$t1
    t2 <- comp$t2
    
    cat("  Comparison:", comp_name, "\n")
    
    # subset to the two timepoints for this comparison
    comp_metadata <- group_metadata_all %>%
      filter(Timepoint %in% c(t1, t2)) %>%
      group_by(PID) %>%
      filter(n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    comp_metadata$PID <- factor(comp_metadata$PID)
    comp_metadata$Timepoint <- factor(comp_metadata$Timepoint, levels = c(t1, t2))
    comp_metadata$Timepoint <- relevel(comp_metadata$Timepoint, ref = t1)
    
    comp_metadata <- as.data.frame(comp_metadata)
    rownames(comp_metadata) <- comp_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE
    
    dge <- dge_global_2wk[, comp_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE]
    comp_metadata <- comp_metadata[colnames(dge), , drop = FALSE]
    
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(dge), rownames(comp_metadata)))
    
    form <- ~ Timepoint + (1 | PID)
    
    v <- voomWithDreamWeights(dge, form, comp_metadata, BPPARAM = param)
    fit <- dream(v, form, comp_metadata, BPPARAM = param)
    fit <- eBayes(fit)
    
    coef_name <- paste0("Timepoint", t2)
    
    res_comp <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
    res_comp$Group <- grp
    res_comp$Comparison <- comp_name
    res_comp$Gene <- rownames(res_comp)
    
    res_comp$Abs_logFC <- abs(res_comp$logFC)
    res_comp$Direction <- ifelse(res_comp$logFC > 0,
                                 paste0("Higher at ", t2),
                                 paste0("Higher at ", t1))
    
    t1_samples <- intersect(comp_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE[comp_metadata$Timepoint == t1], colnames(v$E))
    t2_samples <- intersect(comp_metadata$INVENTORY.CODE[comp_metadata$Timepoint == t2], colnames(v$E))
    
    t1_means_df <- data.frame(
      Gene = rownames(v$E),
      Mean_t1 = rowMeans(v$E[, t1_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    t2_means_df <- data.frame(
      Gene = rownames(v$E),
      Mean_t2 = rowMeans(v$E[, t2_samples, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    names(t1_means_df)[2] <- paste0(t1, "_mean")
    names(t2_means_df)[2] <- paste0(t2, "_mean")
    
    res_comp <- merge(res_comp, t1_means_df, by = "Gene", all.x = TRUE)
    res_comp <- merge(res_comp, t2_means_df, by = "Gene", all.x = TRUE)
    
    sig_genes <- res_comp[res_comp$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ]
    nonsig_genes <- res_comp[res_comp$adj.P.Val >= 0.05, ]
    
    sig_genes <- sig_genes[order(-sig_genes$Abs_logFC), ]
    nonsig_genes <- nonsig_genes[order(nonsig_genes$adj.P.Val), ]
    
    res_comp <- rbind(sig_genes, nonsig_genes)
    
    mean_cols <- c(paste0(t1, "_mean"), paste0(t2, "_mean"))
    
    res_comp <- res_comp[, c(
      "Gene", "Comparison", "Group",
      "logFC", "Abs_logFC", "t", "B", "z.std",
      "P.Value", "adj.P.Val", "Direction",
      "AveExpr", mean_cols
    )]
    
    num_cols <- sapply(res_comp, is.numeric)
    res_comp[num_cols] <- lapply(res_comp[num_cols], signif, digits = 3)
    
    write.csv(
      res_comp,
      file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("DEA_", grp, "_", comp_name, ".csv")),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    
    all_results_2wk_pairwise[[paste(grp, comp_name, sep = "_")]] <- res_comp
    
    cat("    Done.\n")
  }
}

all_results_2wk_pairwise <- bind_rows(all_results_2wk_pairwise)

```

## Load data 
```{r}
high_RRS_ED2WK <- read.csv("2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results/DEA_High_RRS_ED_vs_WK2.csv")

high_RRS_2WK6M <- read.csv("2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results/DEA_High_RRS_WK2_vs_M6.csv")

high_RRS_ED6M <- read.csv("2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results/DEA_High_RRS_ED_vs_M6.csv")

low_RRS_ED2WK <- read.csv("2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results/DEA_Low_RRS_ED_vs_WK2.csv")

low_RRS_2WK6M <- read.csv("2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results/DEA_Low_RRS_WK2_vs_M6.csv")

low_RRS_ED6M <- read.csv("2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Results/DEA_Low_RRS_ED_vs_M6.csv")

all_results_2wk <- bind_rows(high_RRS_ED2WK, high_RRS_2WK6M, high_RRS_ED6M, low_RRS_ED2WK, low_RRS_2WK6M, low_RRS_ED6M)



interval_DEG_count <- all_results_2wk %>%
    group_by(Comparison, Group) %>%
    summarize(Count_DEGS_FDR_0.05 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              Count_DEGS_FDR_0.01 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
              Count_DEGS_FDR_0.001 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.001, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop') %>%
    arrange(Comparison, Group)

write.csv(interval_DEG_count, "2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/DEG Counts Across Intervals and RRS Groupx.csv")

all_results_2wk_v2 <- bind_rows(high_RRS_ED2WK, low_RRS_ED2WK, high_RRS_2WK6M, low_RRS_2WK6M, high_RRS_ED6M, low_RRS_ED6M)

all_results_2wk_export <- all_results_2wk_v2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparison, Group, Gene, logFC, t, B, z.std,P.Value, adj.P.Val,ED_mean, WK2_mean, M6_mean ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Interval = Comparison, 
                `RRS Group` = Group, 
                Gene = Gene, 
                logFC = logFC, 
                `T stat` = t, 
                B = B, 
                `Std Z` = z.std, 
                `P Value` = P.Value, 
                FDR = adj.P.Val, 
                `Avg ED Log2CPM` = ED_mean, 
                `Avg WK2 Log2CPM` = WK2_mean, 
                `Avg 6M Log2CPM` = M6_mean) %>%
  mutate(
  Interval = case_when(
    Interval == "ED_vs_WK2" ~ "ED vs WK2",
    Interval == "WK2_vs_M6" ~ "WK2 vs 6M",
    Interval == "ED_vs_M6" ~ "ED vs 6M",
    TRUE ~ as.character(Interval)
  ), 
    `RRS Group` = case_when(
    `RRS Group` == "High_RRS" ~ "High RRS",
    `RRS Group` == "Low_RRS" ~ "Low RRS",
    TRUE ~ as.character(`RRS Group`)
  ),
   Direction = case_when(
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & logFC > 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & logFC < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & logFC > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & logFC < 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & logFC > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & logFC < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      logFC == 0 ~ "No difference",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
write.csv(all_results_2wk_export, "2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/Combined ED-WK2-6M DEA Results.csv")

```

### Excel export 
```{r}

library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

format_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  signif(x, digits)
}
dea_list <- list(
  "High_RRS_ED_vs_WK2"  = high_RRS_ED2WK,
  "High_RRS_WK2_vs_M6"  = high_RRS_2WK6M,
  "High_RRS_ED_vs_M6"   = high_RRS_ED6M,
  "Low_RRS_ED_vs_WK2"   = low_RRS_ED2WK,
  "Low_RRS_WK2_vs_M6"   = low_RRS_2WK6M,
  "Low_RRS_ED_vs_M6"    = low_RRS_ED6M
)

DEA_wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

for (sheet_name in names(dea_list)) {
  
  df_sub <- dea_list[[sheet_name]] %>%
    mutate(
      adjP_num = as.numeric(adj.P.Val),
      abslogfc_num = as.numeric(Abs_logFC),
      sig = adjP_num < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(sig),
      desc(if_else(sig, abslogfc_num, NA_real_)),
      if_else(!sig, adjP_num, Inf)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-adjP_num, -abslogfc_num, -sig) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_num))
  
  addWorksheet(DEA_wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(DEA_wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df_sub, withFilter = FALSE)
  
  addStyle(
    DEA_wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = header_style,
    rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  addStyle(
    DEA_wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = body_style,
    rows = 2:(nrow(df_sub) + 1), cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), gridExpand = TRUE
  )
  
  setColWidths(DEA_wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df_sub), widths = 18)
}

saveWorkbook(
  DEA_wb,
  "2WK Analyses/Differential Expression Analyses/Summaries/DEA_Results_ED2WK6M_GlobalNorm.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

### Figure 6b
```{r}
volcano_df <- bind_rows(
  high_RRS_ED2WK, low_RRS_ED2WK,
  high_RRS_2WK6M, low_RRS_2WK6M) %>%
  #high_RRS_ED6M,  low_RRS_ED6M) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_FDR = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    neg_log10_FDR = ifelse(is.infinite(neg_log10_FDR), NA_real_, neg_log10_FDR),
    sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05,
    Interval = factor(Interval, levels = c("ED \u2192 2WK", "2WK \u2192 6M", "ED \u2192 6M")),
    RRS_group = factor(RRS_group, levels = c("Low RRS", "High RRS")))

volcano_plot <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_FDR, color = RRS_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = volcano_df %>% filter(sig), alpha = 1, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Interval, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High RRS" = "#2A93B5", "Low RRS" = "#8D1946")) +
  labs(x = expression(log[2]~fold~change), y = expression(-log[10]~FDR), color = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 24) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 1), labels = c("-1", "0", "1")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 0.8))) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -12),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8), 
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"))

volcano_plot

ggsave(volcano_plot, filename = "volcano_plot_for_methods_v2.jpg", width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 300)
```
